g.text: Illustrative price increase for crude oil depends on the price elasticity of demand and the amount
of oil that is exported from the Gulf.
Illustrative impact of Gulf export cuts on oil prices
Illustrative calculation assuming global oil consumption of 100 million barrels per day and pre-war Gulf exports of
20 million barrels per day. Re-worked by freerangestats.info based on original analysis by Haver Analytics.
